customer_output_policy.authority: original customer Excel/Word headers plus promoted equipment overview field-schema nodes
customer_output_policy.value_transfer: forbidden; the profile carries field structure and evidence gates only
customer_output_policy.family_ambiguity: retain the union at the most-general supported family until a deterministic discriminator closes a subtype
customer_output_policy.missing_fields: retain every required row; apply only registered context fallbacks as visibly RECOMMENDED or DEFAULTED preliminary values, and keep formal evidence gaps open

selection_policy.type_screening: allowed after family identity is deterministic
selection_policy.candidate_matching: may consume only the parameter package selection_feature_vector
selection_policy.partial_input: show calculated and missing rows; retain the most general type candidate; do not fabricate a model
selection_policy.formal_model: requires the family evidence gate and independent approval
